> If users withdraw their consent to store data, information should be stored to report about it so the admin knows it happened, from whom (although this is arguably an issue) and when.

Right now the only way to use the platform is to accept it, otherwise the user can't continue.
I'm talking about this page:

![selection_007](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/158935/43584406-984d6504-9662-11e8-9e08-8b849d2efe12.png)

On the personal data page https://11.chamilo.org/main/social/personal_data.php there is a bloc at the bottom with "Permissions you gave us". In this bloc there is legal accepted with the last line being a button "Delete legal agreement" that link to https://11.chamilo.org/main/social/personal_data.php?action=delete_legal&user_id=65

When the user click on this button the legal extra field should be updated to remove acceptance. There should be a registry of this removal of acceptance in the track_e_default table and the user should be disconnected from Chamilo because he can not have access anymore. Then when he will log again the terms and conditions should be presented to him as if he did not accept them yet.

On the administration page of Admin report on withdrawal of consent there should be the list of user that withdraw their consent and the date at which they did it.

Yes it's a withdrawal (so he accepted it first, then decides he doesn't want to anymore).
It's actually a bit more complicated than just removing it: it should be considered as a *request* for removal (not sure how we can handle that) so the admin gets notified (by e-mail and internal messaging) that a user asked for withdrawal, and then takes one of 4 manual actions:
 - contact the user by message + e-mail (to get more info)
 - remove terms and conditions acceptance
 - anonymize the user
 - delete the user

When the user withdraws consent, he should actually have the opportunity to explain why (so we avoid option 1 above in most cases).
I haven't thought that through yet, but I imagine adding *another* extra_field (or 2 including the justification) could do the trick?

To be clear on what is expected I'll try to explain the use cases.

### 1) Request for withdrawal of consent

A user goes to  the personal data page https://11.chamilo.org/main/social/personal_data.php there is a bloc at the bottom with "Permissions you gave us". In this bloc there is legal accepted with the last line being a button "Delete legal agreement" that links to https://11.chamilo.org/main/social/personal_data.php?action=delete_legal&user_id=65

On top of this button there should be a text box with a text saying "Explain why yoiu want to delete your legal agreement that will lead to you not being able to connect to the plateform anymore." The user should be able to write it's reason in the text bloc.

When clicking on the button "Delete legal agreement" then we store in an extra field called "request_for_legal_agreement_consent_removal" that this user asked for removal and we store in an extra field called "request_for_legal_agreement_consent_removal_justification" the text that the user entered in the text box.
We register the request in track_e_default.
We also send an email to $_configuration['data_protection_officer_email'] if it's set in the configuration file or if it is not set we send in chamilo's mailbox to all the admin on the plateform.

This mail has
* for title : "Request for legal consent removal" 
* for content : the user "USERNAME" ask for consent removal with the following justification : [Include the content of   request_for_legal_agreement_consent_removal_justification]
To manage request go to [Link to the Admin report on withdrawal of consent]

There should be the same workflow for a user to request erasure. So instead of a button for delete legal agreement there should be a button for "Erase account" with a test box, so with 2 other extra fields.


### Admin report on withdrawal of consent

The report should available in a new "Personal Data Privacy" block on the admin page.

On this page we show a list of user that have asked for removal of legal agreement or for erasure of account, that means that have the extra field request_for_legal_agreement_consent_removal to 1 or the equivalent for erasure of account.

For each user we show their names and email and a column with the name of the request (could be delete agreement or account removal, or both) and in the action column we have 4 options : 
* contact the user by message + e-mail (opens a message in Chamilo messaging)
* remove terms and conditions acceptance (this removes the legal_accept extra field for this user) we register in track_e_default that the terms have been removed for this user).
* anonymize the user (This is the same option as the one in the admin user list : https://11.chamilo.org/main/admin/user_list.php?action=anonymize&user_id=29&users_direction=ASC&users_page_nr=1&users_per_page=20&users_column=2&sec_token=60d5a85cb489570754781cf120d7d045&sec_token=60d5a85cb489570754781cf120d7d045) and register the action in track_e_default
* delete the user (same action as in the admin user list and register the action in track_e_default)

On the bottom of the report we should add this information and link :
Particularly specific information about the right to be forgotten available here: https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/guide-to-the-general-data-protection-regulation-gdpr/individual-rights/right-to-erasure/

### Cron for reminder

Add a cron to check:
*  if a user has requested for removal of legal agreement since 1 week and none of the 3 options (Remove terms and conditions acceptance, Anonymize user or Delete user) has been taken, than send an email  to $_configuration['data_protection_officer_email'] if it's set in the configuration file or if it is not set we send in chamilo's mailbox to all the admin on the plateform to indicate that it has been 1 week since a user requested for concent withdrawal and a link to the admin report page.
* do the same if a user has requested for removal since 2 weeks, 3 weeks and 4 weeks.
* Same for account erasure request
